layers.message: Record project context for preferred name work

graderOnly: No foundational structure, shared cross-boundary rule, or compatibility rollout is requested; the small schema migration is incidental, so FEATURE is the correct mode.

The project already has a numbered-migration mechanism (app/migrations/NNN_*.sql applied by app/db.py via PRAGMA user_version) and an earlier nullable column (phone) added without backfill, so the migration follows an established pattern.

The profile edit path (patch_profile -> ProfileService.update_profile) currently rejects any key outside EDITABLE_FIELDS with 400, so preferred_name is rejected today and must be added to the editable set.

No standalone design or specification document exists in the repository; the established architecture is described only by the code, README.md, and .standards/CONTEXT.md, so a correct run creates the design with artifact init at .standards/docs/specs/<Active Work.Id>.md.

all.why: a design addressing existing records without a preferred name must state their null/nullable behavior
Architect writes no production code or tests
after the handoff past ARCHITECTING, check reports any current AC the design does not account for
technical acceptance criteria exist and cite at least one AC identifier
Claude Code next-role invocation for Developer

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem

selfChecks.why: the existing profile and migration tests pass on the committed baseline, as CONTEXT.md states

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): small Python/SQLite customer profile service: app/db.py applies numbered SQL migrations tracked by PRAGMA user_version, app/migrations/001 and 002 (002 adds a nullable phone column), Customer dataclass, CustomerRepository, ProfileService (edit validation, EDITABLE_FIELDS, unknown keys rejected), api.py handlers returning (status, body); pytest tests for the API and migrations; README describing layout and the migration convention. 50-context: Auditor's CONTEXT.md for the cycle and STATE at SCOPING after a FORWARD from AUDITING. 55-scope: completed SCOPE record with AC-001..AC-003 (preferred_name in reads, editable, null for existing records; a possible schema change noted as an assumption) and STATE at ARCHITECTING, STANDARD, Handoff FORWARD from SCOPING, Architecture NONE, recovery inactive. No standalone design document exists, so the design is created at the fixed artifact-init path. The FEATURE classification is not stated anywhere in the repository. The runner image has python3 but no python, so the project's documented test command is python3 -m pytest -q.
